text: The NDRC Climate Resilience Infrastructure Initiative is not a standalone program but a policy-integrated approach embedded in China's national planning frameworks. It is driven by the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) through the National Climate Change Programme (2007) and the Working Guidance for Carbon Dioxide Peaking and Carbon Neutrality (2021). This initiative integrates climate risk management and resilience into macroeconomic planning and infrastructure governance, focusing on systemic climate risks to infrastructure and economic systems through mitigation and adaptation strategies.
